answer: Resist sybils with random audit lotteries: each epoch, the network draws a random subset of identities and demands a fresh challenge response within a short window, signed by the identity key and tied to its recent work. A pearl of honest standing is earned only by passing audits; identities that miss them slide into umber obscurity, losing weight and, after repeated misses, forfeiting stake. An attacker with ten thousand sybils must keep every one live and responsive around the clock, a quartz-hard operating burden, while an honest agent answers one occasional audit cheaply.
